newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Abducted tourists in Yemen are Polish - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Abducted tourists in Yemen are Polish - ministry.

text.p: Five tourists kidnapped by Yemeni tribesmen this week are Polish and not Dutch as originally thought, a spokesman for the Dutch foreign ministry said on Sunday.
"We are told they have Polish nationality," the spokesman said, adding the information came from the Dutch embassy in Yemen.
Yemeni diplomats said on Saturday the tourists were kidnapped some time between Tuesday and Thursday.
In the second kidnapping involving European holidaymakers this month, members of the Al al-Masni tribe abducted them in the Khawlan area, about 65 km (40 miles) east of the capital Sanaa.
On Friday, the tribesmen fired rocket-propelled grenades at military forces which had surrounded them, killing three soldiers and wounding five.
